description: This is a Java service class implementing business logic for managing Tag entities, including CRUD operations and lookup methods, within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: TagService
classes.description: Service class responsible for business logic related to Tag entities, including retrieval, creation, deletion, and counting tags.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Tag by its ID with a non-null safeguard.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a Tag by its name after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Tag if a Tag with the same name does not already exist.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of Tag entities.
